Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::chooseOneForReview(requestid: Integer): LoanRequest {
	definition:
		selectedRequest: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequests->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequests.size()>0
	postcondition:
		if selectedRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then CurrentLoanRequest = selectedRequest 
		endif 
}
